programme.title: Chelsea vs Sunderland (MW09) - EP 82
programme.desc: Having won four of their first six Premier League games against Chelsea between 1996 and 2001 (L2), Sunderland have since won just three of their 26 against the Blues (D2 L21).

programme.title: Brentford vs Liverpool (MW09) - EP 85
programme.desc: Having lost just one of their first three Premier League meetings with Liverpool (W1 D1), Brentford have now lost each of their last five against the Reds.

programme.title: Wolverhampton Wanderers vs Arsenal (MW31) - EP 301
programme.desc: Since doing the double over Arsenal in 2020-21, Wolves have now lost each of their last nine against the Gunners in the Premier League.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Nottingham Forest (MW12) - EP 115
programme.desc: Liverpool lost this exact fixture 1-0 last season, the only league game in which they failed to score all season. They’ve not lost consecutive home league games against Nottingham Forest since 1963.

programme.title: Leeds United vs Chelsea (MW14) - EP 138
programme.desc: Leeds have won just one of their last nine Premier League games against Chelsea (D2 L6), though it was in their last meeting at Elland Road in August 2022 (3-0).

programme.title: Manchester City vs Nottingham Forest (MW29) - EP 288
programme.desc: Manchester City have won 16 of their last 19 Premier League home games (D2 L1), at least three more than any other side since April 2025.

programme.title: Bournemouth vs Liverpool (MW23) - EP 225
programme.desc: Liverpool are unbeaten in their last 10 Premier League games, the longest current run of any side (W4 D6). However, they’ve drawn each of their last four, last drawing more consecutive league games in October/November 1980 (5).

programme.title: Arsenal vs Bournemouth (MW32) - EP 312
programme.desc: Having won each of their first eight home games against Bournemouth in all competitions, Arsenal lost this exact league fixture 2-1 last season.

programme.title: Wolverhampton Wanderers vs Liverpool (MW29) - EP 284

Through conflicts and hardships, the two gradually grow. No matter which way the wind blows, this unconventional duo continues their journey in search of happiness.

programme.title: Isteri Misteri
programme.desc: The seemingly content domesticity of a Kuala Lumpur household goes up in flames when a hapless polygamist receives a witch doctor's prophecy that one of his wives is out to kill him but which one?!

programme.title: (L) Berita Wilayah TVS
programme.desc: Berita Wilayah TVS membawakan berita dari negeri-negeri di seluruh negara.

programme.title: Decimal Point
programme.desc: Weekly business show is set to become your trusted source for all things business, economics, and current affairs. Your gateway to making informed decisions in today's fast-paced business environment.

programme.title: (L) Re Bao
programme.desc: Re Bao memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Mandarin.

programme.title: Nomads of the Rainforest
programme.desc: The Penan Legacy is a 3-episode documentary series following a Penan woman's journey from the rainforest to the city, exploring her culture, traditions, and efforts to preserve her heritage.

programme.title: Borneo's Unique Building
programme.desc: Siri dokumentari yang memfokuskan kepada senibina bangunan dan infrastruktur di Sarawak, yang menampilkan dua binaan iaitu satu senibina moden/kontemporari dan satu lagi senibina tradisi/kolonial.

programme.title: (L) Berita Iban TVS
programme.desc: Berita Iban memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Iban.

programme.title: (DL) Menarik Sepuluh
programme.desc: Menarik Sepuluh mengumpulkan 10 kisah unik dan menarik berlaku di mana sahaja.

programme.title: (L) UTAMA 740
programme.desc: UTAMA 740 memaparkan berita terkini yang menyeluruh dan padat dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: (DL) Detik Dunia
programme.desc: Detik Dunia membawakan rangkuman berita antarabangsa, mengetengahkan perkembangan global serta kisah-kisah yang membentuk landskap dunia hari ini.

programme.title: Remarkable Living: Amazing Spaces
programme.desc: Remarkable Living Amazing Spaces, focuses on architectural design in Asia, showcasing innovative homes and commercial space repurposing, while exploring how people inhabit these remarkable environments.

programme.title: Hilang
programme.desc: The murder of an undocumented teenager in the small town of Seri Daik brings Inspector Munir back to the birthplace he left 17 years ago. A religious scholar whom Munir blames for the death of his sister.

programme.title: Inspirasi Duniamu
programme.desc: Inspirasi TVS merupakan segmen berita istimewa yang disampaikan oleh selebriti tempatan dengan mengetengahkan laporan berkaitan rakyat, hiburan serta topik trending.

programme.title: Orang Kita
programme.desc: Bersama MINTRED,memaparkan kisah inspirasi usahawan tempatan.Rancangan ini menyerlahkan semangat juang,ketekunan,dan inovasi yang membawa kejayaan, memberi inspirasi kepada usahawan baru dengan keyakinan.

programme.title: (L) TVS Nightline
programme.desc: Memaparkan laporan peristiwa yang berlaku di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa English.

programme.title: Hwarang: the Poet Warrior Youth
programme.desc: Amidst palace politics spear-headed by an over-ambitious queen who refuses to step down from the throne, Hwarang, a group of warriors, gets trained to protect the kingdom.

programme.title: Barbarossa
programme.desc: During the reign of the Ottoman Empire, four brothers from Lesvos face many dangers and become the conquerors of the seas.

programme.title: Borneo Tech Heroes
programme.desc: Borneo's digital revolution in this documentary,showcasing innovative tech,thriving startups,and how they're transforming communities and reshaping the island's socio-economic landscape in the 4.0 era.

programme.title: Sumandak Takes Borneo
programme.desc: Dewi Remaja 2022 winner Tracie and two friends explore Borneo's beauty-food,history,culture,nature,and diversity-while uplifting communities through local social enterprises in this inspiring travelogue.

programme.title: The Cloth Story
programme.desc: The Cloth Story season 2 focuses on textiles,such as Pua,Songket,Tenun,Batik and Keringkam from the Borneo region. The cloth,the raw materials, the artisans, the history, the evolution and so much more.

programme.title: Headgear Hunting
programme.desc: Dr Welyne Jehom, an anthropologist, search for expert traditional headgear makers in order to deepen her own knowledge of the craft and preserve the tradition for the benefit of future generations.

programme.title: Aroma Malaysia
programme.desc: Aroma Malaysia menampilkan eksplorasi kulinari yang memperkenalkan hidangan tradisional dan tempatan, diperkaya dengan pengalaman pengembaraan merentasi pelbagai destinasi budaya.

programme.title: 3 Mak Dara
programme.desc: 3 Mak Dara kembali untuk Musim Kedua dengan nafas baharu yang lebih bersahaja dan santai. Dihoskan oleh tiga orang selebriti tanah air iaitu Raja Azura, Sharifah Shahora dan Rita Rudaini.

programme.title: My Health, My Choice
programme.desc: My Health, My Choice explores daily practices, behaviors, and health issues, highlighting factors like attitudes, diet, environment, and relationships, and provides practical solutions.

programme.title: Stories in Motion
programme.desc: Five choreographers in Sarawak are given two weeks to create a story using a surprise 'wildcard style', incorporating unique Sarawak genres or styles.

programme.title: Rihlah: Islam Di Borneo
programme.desc: Rihlah: Islam di Borneo menjejaki sejarah dan perkembangan Islam di Sarawak serta hubungannya dengan Sabah, Kalimantan dan Brunei melalui budaya, migrasi dan komuniti tempatan.

programme.title: Belawan Masak
programme.desc: Dua selebriti Cef, Pison Jaujip (Sabah) dan Achang Libat (Sarawak), bersaing memasak menggunakan bahan utama dari hutan atau pasar, dengan cara masakan berbeza, untuk menjadi pemenang 6 episod.

programme.title: (L) TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Joran Borneo
programme.desc: JORAN BORNEO,'Majalah' travelog dalam Bahasa Melayu/dialek tempatan ini bakal menjejaki lokasi-lokasi 'lubuk' ikan di sekitar BORNEO. Siri ini akan dibawa oleh 2 pengacara tempatan dari Sarawak dan Sabah.

programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Luar Biasa
programme.desc: Kisah yang diinspirasikan daripada pemenang pingat emas Paralimpik, Mohamad Ridzuan yang menghadapi penyakit 'Cebral Palsy' dan abangnya yang sentiasa ada di sisinya.

programme.title: Sekolah Api
programme.desc: Api, gangster yang meningkat naik cuba memenuhi amanat arwah neneknya untuk menghabiskan SPM. Dia jatuh cinta dengan guru Bahasa Inggeris dan sanggup melakukan apa saja untuk memenangi hati guru tersebut.

programme.title: Balapan
programme.desc: Kisah empat orang remaja yang telah menjadi musuh sejak sekian lama di lapangan balapan acara pecut 100meter peringkat daerah Selangor dan akhirnya menjadi sahabat seperjuangan.

programme.title: Lampu Merah
programme.desc: Si lelaki sukakan si perempuan, tanpa sedar yang si perempuan itu psiko dan obses dengan cintanya. Cara untuk selamatkan diri hanya dengan jatuh cinta dengan si perempuan semula.

programme.title: Bini Aku Dari...
programme.desc: Lydia dan Rudy telah pun berkahwin. Lydia nak anak walaupun Rudy belum bersedia lagi. Perangai Lydia makin menjadi- jadi apabila mengikut hukum hakam dari kakiberamal.com.

programme.title: Tebus
programme.desc: Anak perempuan Mikail telah di culik dan untuk menyelamatkan anaknya dia cuba mengimbau kembali sejarah lampau dirinya ketika menyertai kumpulan gangster.

programme.title: Survival 486
programme.desc: Syuhada going hiking to Gunung Tahan with her friends. Unfortunately, she got lost and fell into a deep hole and trapped there for 19 days.

programme.title: Cik Paris Diva Kampung
programme.desc: Zulaikha merupakan seroang gadis bandar yang mencabar diri untuk hidup di kampung lalu terpikat dengan jejaka kampung yang berjaya menawan hatinya.

programme.title: Budak Dari Tak Bai
programme.desc: Melalui kehidupan yang getir, Johari meninggalkan Tak Bai pada zaman kanak-kanak ke Kota Bharu. Peristiwa hitam membuatkannya hanyut dalam dunia gelap. Dilakonkan oleh Kamal Adli dan Nabila Huda.

programme.title: Delen
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Delen yang mula rasa terancam apabila Emily mula menyukai pelajar baru bernama Robert. Sejak itu, bermulalah persaingan antara Delen dan Robert demi merebut cinta Emily.

programme.title: Bro Jenin
programme.desc: Kisah Jenin yang telah masuk ke zaman kini. Dia berjumpa dengan seorang animator, Emily. Wujud perbezaan pendapat maka terjadi lah kisah2 lucu dan akhirnya Jenin terpaksa pulang ke tempat asalnya.

programme.title: Bibik Aku Nak Kahwin
programme.desc: Milah yang terlalu berharap untuk berkahwin, akhirnya menemui jodoh secara tiba-tiba. Lakonan Didie Alias, Hairul Azreen dan Nabila AF.

programme.title: Baby-Sita
programme.desc: Two grand-theft-auto and best friends Adam & Hatim discovered a baby at the back seat of a stolen car. Keen to avoid detection, they take care of the baby while figuring out how to return the baby without getting caught.

programme.title: Baby Jarum
programme.desc: Mami Jarum is back! and this time Mami is making sure her grand-daughter Asyikin will marry the man of her choosing, however Asyikin has a better plan (or worse!) for herself.

programme.title: Challenge Accepted
programme.desc: Jeff seorang tiktokers terkenal. Jeff telah berjaya membuat seoarang gadis,Fatimah jatuh cinta padanya tetapi akhirnya Fatimah mendapat tahu yang Jeff hanya menggunakannya demi populariti.

programme.title: Diari Chinta
programme.desc: Chinta selalu gagal dalam cintanya diberikan sebuah diari ajaib untuk menulis babak cinta. Impian yang ditulis Chinta itu menjadi kenyataan dengan kemunculan Ben namun tidaklah selancar yang disangka.

programme.title: Kipas Belum Mati
programme.desc: Mia, seorang artis meningkat naik, membuka kelab peminatnya dan dibantu oleh Lynn yang menjadi pengurus. Dengan bantuan Lynn, kelabnya maju namun ada harga yang harus dibayar di sebalik kejayaan tersebut..

programme.title: Geng
programme.desc: Isabella is an ex-convict who has sworn off her life of crime. Unfortunately, her old gang boss wants her to do one last drug transaction and kidnaps her mother to blackmail Isabella. With the help of her high school best friends, Mariam and Anita, Isabella goes on a road trip to save her mother.

programme.title: Keabadian Cinta
programme.desc: 3 couples falls in love with each other in 3 different love stories.

programme.title: Boyfriend Aku Dari ...
programme.desc: After being disappointed multiple times, Risya is introduced by a friend to Andy, a nerdy young man. They fall in love but in actuality, Andy is a boyfriend from 'hell'!

programme.title: Gengster Leng Chai
programme.desc: Black is a failure of a gangster, being too soft hearted with people. After meeting Mawar, he is determined to change despite the objections of others.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Sesat Kat Paris
programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.title: Nota Silam
programme.desc: Munirah menjumpai sebuah nota cinta di dalam sebuah buku yang diperolehi secara rambang dari 'blind date with a book' dan cuba untuk menemukan pasangan di dalam nota tersebut yang merubah hidup Munirah.

programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche
programme.desc: Seorang penulis skrip kisah-kisah cinta tetapi masih bersendirian mengimpikan cinta dalam kehidupan realitinya, lalu dia menyertai sebuah kumpulan terapi untuk berkongsi masalah peribadinya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.desc: Powerful, insane and obsessed with hatred, the bride with white hair has gone on a killing rampage, and can only be stopped by the one person she loves.

programme.title: There Is No Escape From Fate
programme.desc: An innocent Hong Kong businessman is wrongfully imprisoned in a brutal multinational prison, and must escape the sadistic warden's torture to survive.

programme.title: Resurrection

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: The first Bollywood movie made in Hong Kong, it is about an interracial love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy! Faced with many difficulties, can their love prevail?

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: Hong Kong Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee, a production head of an advertising firm, runs into her ex-boyfriend before a commercial shoot & drowns her sorrows drinking at Lan Kwai Fong. She picks herself up with Chan's help.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over her young son's death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship?

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Ah Mei, bound by cerebral palsy and her mother's push for a forced hysterectomy, finds love with Ken through a disability intimacy service. Together, they forge a tender bond that defies all barriers.

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Feng defies his father and leaves home to pursue his dream of becoming an auto mechanic. Along the way, he unexpectedly finds himself drawn into the thrilling world of car racing.

programme.title: Vital Signs
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being assigned to a new station. Though he clashes with Ma's unconventional methods, Wang soon rediscovers the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: Adapted from a novel of the same name by Erica Li, an urban sketcher suffering from ALS asks his crush to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty \"Mission Impossible\"! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: De & family goes on a drive to Changbai Mountain, where their magical holiday turns tragic when their 8-year-old son goes missing. Will they be able to find him before the cold winter takes him?

programme.title: All U Need is Love
programme.desc: When a luxury hotel in Hong Kong suddenly becomes a Coronavirus superspreader, guests & the staff are faced with a 14-day trial they may not survive.

programme.title: Endless Battle
programme.desc: Two brothers, a drug lord and a police officer, are involved in a drug cartel's turf battle. After the younger brother's hidden identity as a drug lord is unveiled, an endless battle begins.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: A sozzled police inspector (Jackie Chan) must pull himself up again after a bungled mission causes his entire team to be wiped out.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: The Way We Dance
programme.desc: When Fleur join her university's hip hop team, a journey begins which lead her into the heated world of dance competitions and a complicated romance.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his family's expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan resents their fraudulent ways. However, when fate shows him a route to redeeming their reputation, will he survive it?

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Stephen Chow stars in this parody on the popular Judge Pao stories, depicting how he helps a rape victim fight the system against corrupt lawyers & officials.

programme.title: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: Featuring three stories about two high school friends, a magician and a lost man, the movie reveals the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Another Me
programme.desc: One day, Constable Li Mao accidentally discovers that he looks exactly like the prince. Wanting a better life for himself, Li agrees to switch places with the prince, who wants freedom.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths.

programme.title: The Dumpling Queen
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters after a failed marriage. She builds a dumpling stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises to become the city's renowned \"Dumpling Queen\".

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: When a former boxing champ and a rich man's son both enter an MMA competition, they believe they are powerful - until they meet an even more formidable opponent.

programme.title: The Way We Keep Dancing
programme.desc: This sequel features the plight of Hong Kong's grassroots performing artists fighting against the government's plan to gentrify an industrial district where they lived.

programme.title: Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: After a catastrophe, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing are saved, but their bodies will soon dissipate. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them with the Seven-Coloured Lotus, hoping to change their destiny.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling, who dreams of becoming a secret agent, accidentally rescues an injured spy. He agrees to make her his apprentice, turning her upside down as she goes on madcap adventures.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Tiger Wong is ambushed after taking the Lousha Plaque, but is saved by his brother and also befriends Turbo Shek. To avenge the death of Dragon Gate masters, the trio vow to defeat Lousha Clan leader.

programme.title: S Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk must work with Inspector Lau to bring down a crime syndicate involved in illegal soccer betting. Though they did not start things well, they managed to complete the task together.

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: During the 1920s White Terror period, agent Li Yimin is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. Alone and hunted, he reunites with an old ally to escape the enemy's trap.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A huge hit in the HK, this typical Stephen Chow movie combines history, science fiction, martial arts & comedy elements makes it a fun watch.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Li goes undercover to shut down Life Hotel but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As he realizes it serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and his empathy.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Septet : The Story of Hong Kong
programme.desc: Starring Sammo Hung, Ann Hui, Patrick Tam, Yuen Wo Ping, Johnnie To & more, Hong Kong's seven most revered directors compose an anthology of stories for their beloved city.

programme.title: Where the Wind Blows
programme.desc: Two notorious corrupt police officers, Detectives Lui Lok and Nam Kong were found to build a corruption network between the triad and police, the ICAC begins to hunt them down to end their control.

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: A team of investigators was sent to an old building believed to be haunted by evil spirits, only to discover an unexpected secret concerning the future of the structure.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: It is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community!

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: A young priest striving to save lost souls crosses paths with a prostitute seeking refuge in the church to escape her debts, they get entangled in a CID investigation into a prostitution ring.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: Fallen boxing star \"Golden Boy\" Chang Li, after a decade in prison, must reconnect with the son he has never met. He rediscovers his purpose and returns to the ring to become the father his son deserves.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mother's sickness & her younger sister's misdiagnoses with SARS.

programme.title: Z Storm
programme.desc: An ICAC investigator uncovers the huge fraud scheme of an organized corrupt group involving the government's $15 billion 'Care Fund'. He must fight against them to keep Hong Kong corruption free.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon

programme.title: Ready o/r Rot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi face pre-marital strife. Meanwhile, Grey Bear doubts his wife's fidelity and Ken faces a life crisis following his girlfriend's pregnancy. Can they resolve their relationship issues?

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: Five bounty hunters are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings plaguing a hotel group in Bangkok. Can they solve the crime and finally collect the bounty?

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended version)
programme.desc: In this Hong Kong comedy, three Chang brothers learn love needs care, not haste or selfishness. This extended cut adds a shootout scene missing from the 2016 Lunar New Year release.

programme.title: One Second
programme.desc: In Zhang Yimou's screen gem that captures the power of cinema, a labour camp escapee seeks a newsreel that captures a one-second glimpse of his daughter. However, he has competition.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: To make a living, Teddy accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. His career regains momentum after reunites with his long-lost daughter.

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: Hua, Fei and Guo are robbed when transporting gang money. When Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Battle Of The Wolf
programme.desc: A former special forces sergeant must protect his wife and fellow passengers aboard a hijacked plane, using his courage and tactical expertise to take down the terrorists and ensure everyone's safety.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a visually impaired factory worker living in an island. After a hurricane cut them off from the outside world, a monster suddenly appears, turning whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Hao Ren inherits the skills of Locksmith Shan and befriends Detective Liu who often seeks his help. When Hao Ren unveils the mystery of Shan's wife's disappearance one day, strange events ensue.

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: Based on the Mekong River massacre, Zhang Han Yu & Eddie Peng star as members of a task force bent on bringing down a drug cartel, with Malaysia providing the backdrops for breath-taking action scenes.

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: The owner of a small cleaning company, Chak, experiences a tough time during the pandemic. When he employs single mother Candy as his assistant, she became his saving grace.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer becomes entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives. When the girl he likes dies mysteriously, he uncovers the secret of a 'ghost marriage'.

programme.title: Love Never Ends
programme.desc: Two elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: Legend of the Fist:The Return of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: As Japan's grip on China tightens, Chen Zhen returns to Shanghai to infiltrate the notorious Club Casablanca, whose owner is a Japanese collaborator.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: Last Suspect
programme.desc: A lawyer must defend a murder suspect and win the case in order to save her daughter who has been taken hostage. As evidence emerges, she unveils the truth and the man behind the case.

programme.title: To Live And Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: Disoriented and trapped in notorious, vice-ridden Mongkok, a once-feared triad figure struggles to adapt to life in the wake of his 30-year prison sentence.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brother's death. He meets Dr. Hui & becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brother's accident.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: A Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.desc: After a series of mysterious murders, including the \"faceless female corpse\" & the \"sealed stone coffin case\.

programme.desc: Rian kembali bersikap dingin pada Adif. Adif tak faham kenapa. Rian pergi jumpa Fitrin lagi dan nak tahu tentang hubungan Fitrin dengan Adif. programme.title: Dihatiku Ada Kamu
programme.desc: Rian tanya kenapa Adif dan Afeeq datang ke butiknya. Afeeq risau, Rian marah sebab sibuk nak tahu hal dia. Adif juga tak suka cara Rian, lalu bawa Rian pulang. Adif, tanya tentang siapa Indri. Rian dan Adif bergaduh . Afeeq tanya Indri tentang hubungan dengan Rian. Indri kata dia tak ganggu isteri orang, tapi Afeeq tetap beri amaran. Rian beritahu Adif dia nak ke Vietnam urusan kerja. Rian tak mahu jumpa Adif lagi sebab dia dah penat nak layan semua kerenah dan cemburu Adif. Tarikh dua bulan sudah hampir dan ia buatkan Adif susah hati sebab Rian sudah menjauhinya semula. Fitrin tunggu Adif, ugut akan ganggu keluarga jika Adif tak jumpa dia. Adif marah, cekak leher Fitrin. Faisal datang, Adif lepaskan Fitrin dan pergi. Adif memandu laju ke sekolah Farhan, risau sesuatu berlaku. Dia terlanggar tembok selepas mengelak kereta lain. Adif cedera, Rian terkejut dan apabila Rian pulang ke Malaysia, Farhan sudah ikut Adif dan Adif mahu ambil Farhan. Rian mengaku dia salah sangka dan tuduh Adif macam macam. Mereka bergaduh besar sehingga Adif hampir melafazkan cerai tapi Rian cuba merayu.

Pergaduhan Luqman dan Lufia semakin melarat sehingga Lufia sanggup menghina kerjaya Luqman sebagai pemandu lori. Ini semua disebabkan Dani mula berjaya meracuni fikiran Lufia.

programme.title: 11 Cinta Sebelum Kamu
programme.desc: Ray, bekas playboy, melamar tunangnya Khadeja. Namun ibunya, Dato' Shikin - seorang ibu tunggal dan peguam - menetapkan syarat unik untuk restu: Ray mesti meminta maaf secara peribadi kepada 11 bekas teman wanitanya, merakam momen itu dalam tempoh 30 hari.

programme.title: Abang Lori Ohsem
programme.desc: Nek Wan kembali pulih. Dia berusaha untuk satukan Luqman dengan Lufia. Lufia masih dengan egonya. Lufia buat keputusan drastic apabila ingin kembali semula pada Dani. Tanpa sedar, Dani cuba untuk merogol Lufia dan telah diselamatkan oleh Luqman. Kali ini Luqman pula meninggikan egonya, terasa benci dengan Lufia kerana Lufia pernah menghinanya. Konflik bertambah lagi apabila Dani dan Luqman bergaduh di pejabat atas perebutan kuasa. Dani mengugut Luqman untuk tinggalkan syarikat tu sekiranya ingin melihat keluarga Luqman selamat. Akhirnya Luqman meninggalkan syarikat bapanya dan kembali dalam dunia lorinya. Lufia masih memujuk rayu Luqman dan Lufia mula mengetahui yang Luqman adalah anak kandung Dato Husin.

programme.desc: Leyla menjejaki asal usul nota itu ke sebuah bandar kecil. Di sana, dia menemui seorang lelaki yang kelihatan seperti Kenan tetapi tidak mempunyai ingatan tentangnya. Dia menggunakan nama yang berbeza, menjalani kehidupan yang damai. Tetapi adakah itu benar-benar dia?

programme.title: Dear Hyeri
programme.desc: Eun-ho semakin tertekan dengan konflik dalaman. Hye-ri menulis surat kepada Eun-ho, merayu untuk hidup bebas sebagai dirinya sendiri. Trauma masa lalu terus menghantui Eun-ho.

programme.title: Pemuja Rahsia
programme.desc: Adam, pelajar kolej yang popular dan juara debat, gemar menyertai marathon. Hawa, jiran Adam, sudah lama menyukai Adam selepas dia menyelamatkannya daripada lemas 18 tahun lalu. Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. Hawa percaya dia dan Adam ditakdirkan bersama, tetapi mereka jarang berkomunikasi. Hawa seorang gadis pendiam, gemar warna hitam, mekap pelik, dan muzik.

programme.title: Romantika 4 Hari 3 Malam
programme.desc: Seorang tetamu lain di pulau itu mula menimbulkan konflik antara Lana dan Amar. Salah faham semakin membesar apabila rahsia kecil terbongkar. Lana terpaksa membuat keputusan sama ada mahu terus percaya atau pulang membawa hati yang kecewa. Amar pula berusaha mempertahankan apa yang baru dibina.

programme.title: Romantika 4 Hari 3 Malam
programme.desc: Lana mula menyiasat latar belakang Amar secara diam-diam. Apa yang ditemuinya membuatkan dia semakin keliru dengan perasaannya sendiri. Dalam masa yang sama, Amar sedar Lana mula menjauh. Pulau yang indah itu kini menjadi saksi pergelutan emosi mereka.

programme.title: Romantika 4 Hari 3 Malam
programme.desc: Satu insiden tidak dijangka menyebabkan Lana dan Amar terperangkap bersama, memaksa mereka berterus terang tentang perasaan masing-masing. Buat pertama kali, dinding antara mereka mula runtuh. Namun bayangan masa lalu masih belum hilang sepenuhnya. Kejujuran itu datang bersama risiko besar.

programme.title: Romantika 4 Hari 3 Malam
programme.desc: Hubungan mereka mula mekar, tetapi tidak semua pihak gembira dengan perubahan itu. Seorang individu dari luar pulau muncul membawa berita yang mengubah segalanya. Lana mula meragui semua yang dia percaya sebelum ini. Amar pula berdepan pilihan sukar antara masa lalu dan masa depan.

programme.desc: Seorang wanita menghidap amnesia sementara , hanya bertahan selama sehari. Rakan sekerjanya yang pemalu dan diam-diam mencintainya memberitahu bahawa mereka adalah pasangan, semata-mata untuk merasai pengalaman bersama dengannya walaupun hanya untuk satu hari.

programme.desc: Anna Lisa, seorang suri rumah, menyiasat kematian misteri jirannya melalui podcast jenayah bersama dua wanita lain. Dalam mencari kebenaran, dia berdepan ugutan, pengkhianatan dan kehilangan, namun akhirnya menemui semula tujuan hidupnya.

programme.title: Dear Hyeri
programme.desc: Kisah silam terbongkar, Hye-ri ialah nama adik Eun-ho yang telah meninggal dunia. Eun-ho secara tidak sedar mencipta personaliti adiknya demi menebus rasa bersalah. Dia cuba melepaskan masa lalu dan memutuskan untuk berpisah dengan Hyun-oh.

programme.title: #SoKampung
programme.desc: Khalisha, seorang gadis yang membesar di kampung, Kuala Selangor. Dengan ibu bapa penyayang, Maryam dan Ahmad. Khalisha dikelilingi sawah padi dan jalan kampung, tetapi obses dengan kehidupan glamor seorang blogger fesyen dan usahawan terkenal, Viva Yusuf. Dia berangan untuk cantik dan bergaya seperti Viva, dan bersembunyi di Instagram dengan nama samaran "Kylie".

programme.title: Bib
programme.desc: Marr cuba memberitahu Affan yang Ajib cuba mengkhianat Bib. Affan tidak percaya kerana terlalu masalah yang harus difikirkan. Semasa berlatih Ajib sengaja membuatkan Affan marah. Namun Affan tetap sabar. Affan mengajak Sara untuk makan malam dirumah. Begitu juga Zarina yang mengajak Dian untuk ke rumah.

programme.title: Yes Sir…Nak Pergi Mana?
programme.desc: Hasrat Fidie untuk berkahwin dengan Zirra ditentang oleh Pn Nisa kerana Zirra pemandu teksi. Fidie mengugut Pn Nisa.

programme.title: Dihatiku Ada Kamu
programme.desc: Rian tanya kenapa Adif dan Afeeq datang ke butiknya. Afeeq risau, Rian marah sebab sibuk nak tahu hal dia. Adif juga tak suka cara Rian, lalu bawa Rian pulang. Adif, tanya tentang siapa Indri. Rian dan Adif bergaduh . Afeeq tanya Indri tentang hubungan dengan Rian. Indri kata dia tak ganggu isteri orang, tapi Afeeq tetap beri amaran. Rian beritahu Adif dia nak ke Vietnam urusan kerja. Rian tak mahu jumpa Adif lagi sebab dia dah penat nak layan semua kerenah dan cemburu Adif. Tarikh dua bulan sudah hampir dan ia buatkan Adif susah hati sebab Rian sudah menjauhinya semula. Fitrin tunggu Adif, ugut akan ganggu keluarga jika Adif tak jumpa dia. Adif marah, cekak leher Fitrin. Faisal datang, Adif lepaskan Fitrin dan pergi. Adif memandu laju ke sekolah Farhan, risau sesuatu berlaku. Dia terlanggar tembok selepas mengelak kereta lain. Adif cedera, Rian terkejut dan apabila Rian pulang ke Malaysia, Farhan sudah ikut Adif dan Adif mahu ambil Farhan. Rian mengaku dia salah sangka dan tuduh Adif macam macam. Mereka bergaduh besar sehingga Adif hampir melafazkan cerai tapi Rian cuba merayu.

programme.title: Bidadari Tanpa Syurga
programme.desc: Azlan mengambil keputusan mengejutkan untuk berkahwin dengan Aisyah. Keputusan itu dirahsiakan daripada Farhah dan dipertahankan atas alasan tanggungjawab agama.

programme.title: Dihatiku Ada Kamu
programme.desc: Rian pengsan dan bila sedar dia sudah berada di rumah baru Adif. Adif jaga Rian dengan baik dan Farhan sudah pun Idris dan Rania bawa pulang dahulu. Rian bersyukur Adif tidak menceraikannya. Hubungan mereka kembali baik dan Rian sedari keikhlasan Adif tapi berlaku salah faham pula apabila Rian dengar perbualan telefon Adif dengan seseorang. Rian sangka Adif nak perangkap dia saja. Rian larikan diri. Adif cuba terangkan sekali lagi sehingga kali ini Adif sudah putus asa sebab Rian masih tak percayakannya. Adif beri syarat jika Rian pergi, akan jatuh satu talak. Dan Rian pergi dengan rasa amat sedih. Idris beritahu, Rian dan Adif salah faham. idris percaya Adif lebih daripada Rian. Adif datang. Adif terangkan. apa yang Rian dengar malam tadi adalah untuk stalker iaitu Fitrin, bukan Rian. Adif jelaskan tentang manipulasi Fitrin. Fitrin datang serang mereka tanpa mereka jangka sehingga tertikam Adif semasa Adif nak selamatkan Rian. Afeeq juga sedar Fitrin telah pergunakan dia juga. Fitrin dapat ditangkap. Hujung kisah proses rujuk semula antara Rian dan Adif setelah masing masing tidak dapat hidup sendiri dan dihat mereka masih ada cinta antara sesama mereka.

Jerry sanggup mengeluarkan modal bagi Aizat memperkembangkan perniagaan Food Truck mereka. Di rumah, Hanim bergaduh besar dengan Aizat, dia menyalahkan Aizat kerana tidak mampu memberinya kemewahan. Hjh Suhaily kecewa apabila Waiz memutuskan pertunangan dengan anak bongsunya Suraya. 6 tahun kemudian, Zalina melahirkan anak lelaki dinamakan Danish. Fira membuka perniagaan secara online, dia berkawan baik dengan Nazim melalui perniagaan mayanya. Hubungan Fira dengan Dian tidak semesra lalu.

programme.title: Yes Sir…Nak Pergi Mana?
programme.desc: Zirra memerhati dari jauh perkembangan terbaharu Fidie. Cintanya pada Fidie masih tidak pernah pudar. Namun Zirra tahu Fidie masih marah padanya. Di saat akhir sebelum syarikat pelancongan Fidie terpaksa ditutup dia mendapat satu tawaran untuk pakej umrah yang berterusan dari sebuah syarikat swasta. Pada mulanya Fidie tidak mahu menerima tawaran itu kerana menyangka Zirra menolongnya.Pemilik syarikat itu datang ke pejabat Fidie. Ternyata bukan Zirra. Fidie kembali bersemangat untuk memajukan syarikatnya.

programme.title: Live: Commonwealth Games 360
programme.desc: Coverage from the day session on day one of the Games, which take place in Glasgow. The games first took place back in Hamilton, Canada in 1930 and took place again in 1934 and 1938, before being cancelled in 1942 and 1946 because of the Second World War. Since its return in 1950 the games have continued to take place every four years and are being held in Glasgow for the second time in 12 years, having previously been held in the Scottish city in 2014. Events taking place today include swimming and para swimming, boxing, para powerlifting and artistic gymnastics.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.
